subject: Notes on WKWebView evaluateJavaScript bridge
text:
Hey Nikita,

I tested the WKWebView completion handler on macOS 15.6. Passing NSJSONWritingOptions::FragmentsAllowed serializes the JS string return cleanly. Let me know when you push M16 so I can run the smoke script on the M3 Max.

Cheers,
Elena
